title: Lesson 5: Free Build
goal: Your bench. Build whatever you like: every component is unlocked, there is no failure state, and your agent has the full toolbox.
hints: Try a voltage divider: two resistors in series, then measure across the lower one with a voltmeter.
A fuse in series with your battery is cheap insurance while you experiment.
Ask your agent to build something for you, then approve or reject each step.
